title: Transform! A New Hero, a New Me

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, hurry, hurry-!
It's already started-!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right in the middle of summer training
camp.
After training wrapped up,
Biko Pegasus dragged me to—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-! This really feels like summer-!
Grilled carrots and cotton candy sound great,
but—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
First,
I've gotta find my ultimate treasure...
a Carrotman mask!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I had one when I was little!
But they're super rare,
so I've never seen one since!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But right now,
Carrotman's getting a rerun on TV!
So I thought maybe they'd be selling...
Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Passing Man
text_block_list.text:
Man, talk about nostalgic—
*Nutritional Warrior Carrotman*!
There weren't many left,
but I'm so glad I got a mask~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh... WHAAATTT-?!
T-T-Trainer! This is bad,
we gotta hurry...!

text_block_list.name: Mask Vendor
text_block_list.text:
You're in luck,
little lady! Sold out everywhere else!
So this right here is truly the very last
one.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All... RIIIGHT~~!! Okay, mister—

text_block_list.name: Biko & Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
One Carrotman mask, please!
......Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning toward the voice,
I see a young boy standing there.
He's panting hard,
as if he's been running all over looking
for a mask.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Do you love Carrotman too...?
......

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Good for you, kid! The truth is,
I already have one at home!
So make sure you take good care of this
mask!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure...? Yay, thank you!
I'll treasure it forever, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Did you see that, Trainer?!
His smile was the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine!
After all,
heroes fight to protect everyone's smiles!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So something like this is...
nothing to sweat over......
—......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to be there for Biko Pegasus.
With that thought in mind,
I spoke the words she once taught me.
choice_data_list: Relying on others is nutrition for...
Relying on others is nutrition for...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
! ......Um, hey.
Trainer, you're my fellow hero, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There's something I wanna ask of you...
It might sound pretty selfish,
but... I...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I really don't wanna give up on getting a
Carrotman mask...!
Will you look for one with me...?
choice_data_list: Of course! We'll definitely find one!
Yeah! Let's definitely track one down!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with her,
we visit every mask stall at the festival.
However,
it seems Carrotman masks are sold out
everywhere—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Dammit~...!

text_block_list.name: Mask Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are!
I heard you're still looking, and
a place came to mind. If you're lucky,
maybe there...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting the details from the vendor,
Biko Pegasus and I dash out of the
festival.
Running with all our might clinging to a
ray of hope, we arrive—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Th... There!
Look, Trainer-!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The festival stall corner inside the hot
spring resort...!
There really was a Carrotman mask!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...~~! Amazing!
This isn't a dream, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
When I was little,
whenever I wore this mask,
I really felt like I'd become the hero I
looked up to!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But I played with it so much that it
broke...!
And I always dreamed of getting my hands on
another one...!
choice_data_list: I'm so glad you got your treasure ...
I'm really glad you found your tre...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Hey, there's still plenty of time
before curfew, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I really wanna play Carrotman pretend just
like when I was a kid.
So...
will you play along with me for just a
bit?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
! Heheh...! There you are,
Grease Monster Lardron!
I won't let you have your way!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nutritious! Righteous!
Carotene charge—Carrotman!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I will protect everyone's health-!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After staging an epic battle with little
Carrotman and having a blast,
we decided to take the bus back to the camp
lodge... but.
choice_data_list: We're at the bus stop... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was breathing softly in her sleep.
Waking her up
felt wrong... and just then,
an idea crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh...? Are we... moving...?)
(Wait... don't tell me...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(...Ehehe... Trainer's back
is so warm...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: (...Just a little longer... like this...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus didn't feel heavy at all.
Trying not to wake her,
I quietly headed up to the lodge—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, you can let me down here!
Heheh... sorry for being a handful.
choice_data_list: I'm just glad I could help.
I'm glad I could be there for you.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
having you around... No... Being able to
rely on you, Trainer—I'm so glad I could!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I always thought...
a hero has to be strong.
That leaning on someone else just wasn't an
option... but.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
When your heart is weak,
relying on your allies gives you strength.
That's what the hero I look up to said.
So—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're a hero,
it's okay to lean on your
friends when you feel like crying.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't get me wrong!
When that kid at the festival
smiled, I was truly happy! But—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That ache in my chest was real, too.
...So,
if I ever feel like I'm about to break down
again...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
When that happens... can I lean on you,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Because as long as I get energy from my
allies,
I know I can get back up no matter how many
times I fall.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to become the greatest hero—
one who can make
everyone smile! Together with you,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer,
and as her fellow hero in arms.
I felt a burning resolve to support her all
the way.
